name: codex-connection-doctor
title_zh: 断连报错先分层定位再动手的 Codex 网络医生
tagline_zh: 反复重连、stream-disconnected 时，不再盲试重启。按层排查 TLS/代理/认证，给证据链修复。
tagline_en: Stop blind restarts on repeated reconnects or stream drops. Pinpoint the failing layer (TLS/proxy/auth), apply.
desc_en: Diagnose and resolve Codex Desktop, CLI, or IDE repeated reconnecting and stream-disconnected errors by identifying the failing connection layer, applying evidence-backed fixes, and reproducing the original workflow.
why_zh: 它不猜，先定位失败层；修复带证据，不靠运气；修完自动复现原流程，验证真好了才收工。
why_en: No guessing: it isolates the failing layer, fixes with evidence, and auto-replays your original workflow to verify the cure.
limit_zh: 只针对 Codex 的 Desktop/CLI/IDE 连接类错误；需要能复现的步骤；不处理非网络类崩溃。
limit_en: Only for Codex Desktop/CLI/IDE connection errors; needs reproducible steps; won't fix non-network crashes; may require manual proxy/cert confirmation.
title_en: Codex connection doctor: diagnose & fix reconnect errors.
